title: Simple divalent metal salts as robust and efficient initiators for the ring-opening polymerisation of rac-lactide
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38079-38084
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07747D, Paper

Simple salts such as Zn(OBn)2 are robust and efficient initiators for lactide polymerisation, delivering poly(lactic acid) under industrially relevant conditions.
